system.description:
You mold wind Release Chakra to create a blade of wind release chakra that is so compressed it fits into the palm of your hand and the blade is so sharp, its able to cut through any defense put Infront of it.

Make a melee ninjutsu attack, with a +2 bonus to its critical threat range, dealing 10d6 wind damage on a hit and forcing the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw, gaining 5 ranks of Bleed on a failed save.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d6 and its critical threat range by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank and you score a critical hit with it, the resulting impact is enough to decimate not just its target, but all creatures surrounding it. All creatures within 20-feet of the original target (excluding the original target) must make a dexterity saving throw, taking 6d6 wind damage and gain 5 ranks of Bleed on a failed save.
